name: Seward
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Seward for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (the City of Seward Christmas Tree Lighting) through December 31 (New Year's Eve Fireworks in Seward), with the Community Holiday Party at the Alaska SeaLife Center (December 2) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Seward

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Seward
  • 2 free events: the City of Seward Christmas Tree Lighting and the Community Holiday Party at the Alaska SeaLife Center
  • Meet Santa: none listed on the events on this page
  • Parades and tree lightings: the City of Seward Christmas Tree Lighting (November 28), plus the New Year's Eve fireworks (December 31)
  • Trains: none listed on this page; see our Seward Depot guide for the Alaska Railroad
  • Season: November 28 to December 31

Planning a bigger day out? Seward families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Anchorage, which covers Zoo Lights, Brighter Winter Nights, The Nutcracker with Eugene Ballet and Winter Wonder Fest.
